title: Calcifer
description: Calcifer, a fire demon in his hearth: Claude's animated persona. He talks while Claude's replies are spoken (lip-synced to the real audio, word timings and phonemes in feed mode) and shows whatever mood Claude gives him.

mood.help: Set Calcifer's expression (held until changed, or for --for seconds)

react.help: A one-shot reaction: flare up, sputter low, throw sparks, wince

mic.help: The user's mic: off, wake (his own spotter listens here for his name, nothing leaves the machine), or open (a conversation, mic live in the room)

mute.help: Mute or unmute his voice (he still mouths the words)

micDevice.label: Your microphone (Automatic: the default mic, skipping loopback and virtual devices)

relayUrl.label: Relay URL (the voice channel: speech feed and the mic room's tokens)

authToken.label: Authorization token for the relay (blank: none)

feedSession.label: Speech feed session id (blank: this project)

wakeSensitivity.label: Wake sensitivity (%) — 50 is the trained setting, measured at one false wake per 11 hours; higher catches near-misses like "Kelsifer" and wakes him more often

voiceInterrupt.label: Say his name to cut him off mid-reply (clicking him always works)

quietSeconds.label: End the conversation after this long with nobody talking (seconds)

followUpSeconds.label: Hold the mic open this long after he finishes, so you can answer without calling him again (0 = off)

commandWisps.label: Show what he's working on as wisps of flame rising off him

stepRate.label: Animate on twos: poses a second (0 = fully smooth)
